title: Loved the colander until the foot broke off.
text: Loved the colander until the foot broke off.. This colander was attractive and functioned great!  I love that the holes weren't too big for my angel hair pasta.  One day my daughter dropped it and one of the feet came off.  I had to give it only 3 stars because of lack of durability.  The foot should not have broken off just from being dropped.

product_metadata.title: Norpro KRONA Stainless Steel 8.5 Inch Deep Colander
features: Satiny, brushed-steel exterior finish; polished, high-luster interior
Heavy gauge tubular handles and tripod feet
description: Functional yet finely crafted, this professional Norpro stainless-steel colander moves easily from the kitchen as a chef's helper to the dining room as a suitable serving piece. Use it to wash or drain everything from large vegetables to boiled pastas or potatoes, meats, and puddings. Medium-size holes allow water to flow freely and are also perfect for ricing cooked food. Krona stainless-steel products won't chip or dent; they're guaranteed to last a lifetime. Each base is tri-ply, with an inner layer of aluminum for added durability.
